steps.text: This state should not be reachable, please make a report with a screenshot in the Quest Helper discord.
Read the noticeboard in the Auburnvale bar to start the quest.
Talk to Marcus in the Auburnvale bar.
Talk to the Bartender in the Auburnvale bar.
Talk to the Shopkeep in the Auburnvale General store.
Talk to Ictus, north of the Auburnvale Quetzal.
Talk to citizens of Auburnvale about the missing people.
Talk to Aemilia and Francis, north of the Auburnvale General store, about their missing sons.
Inspect the wall outside Aemilia and Francis' house.
Inspect the puddle outside Aemilia and Francis' house.
Follow the puddle trail and inspect the plank in the river, west of Auburnvale.
Follow the trail west of the city, then through the mountains, and enter the cave.
Talk to the Injured boy inside the cave.
Reinforce the wall outside Aemilia and Francis' house.
Talk to Captain Ariadna, south-west of the Auburnvale General store, and inform her about the missing people.
Climb upstairs of Aemilia and Francis' house and talk to Etz.
Talk to Etz, upstairs of Aemilia and Francis' house, about what he remembers.
Climb downstairs, then head back to the cave.
Kill the strange creatures. Protect from Melee works to avoid most damage.
Talk to Antos in the eastern part of the cave, ready to fight three Strange creatures. Protect from Melee works to avoid all damage.
Talk to Captain Ariadna in Auburnvale to finish the quest!

rewards: Access to the Custodia Pass Slayer Dungeon
